title: Face Sculpt #250 (일본 · 30대 · 광기 어린 · 바비 인형(갈색 머리) · 정면 · 유형 고유 메이크업 · P200 · 청동 추 10개/귀 3구멍 · 테마 해양(진주·조개·산호) · 배경 실내 청록 벨벳 라운지 · 스티커)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Western woman, mid 20s, with a Barbie-pink glam look pushed to its extreme — fair skin with real visible pores and a soft rosy blush high on the apple cheeks, long, glossy chestnut-brown curls past her shoulders. Her eyes are gigantic: perfectly round, very wide-set, extra-large eyes with a huge visible iris, violet-blue big-iris contact lenses that make the iris look enormous, both eyes exactly the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated, with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, bright real catchlights and genuine depth, framed by extremely long, thick, dramatically curled false lashes top and bottom and high, softly arched eyebrows. Her lips are extremely plump: huge, round, voluptuous, high-volume lips in glossy coral-pink gloss, projecting visibly forward from her face, with a very pronounced cupid's bow and a full, pillowy lower lip, softly closed in a sweet faint smile. A tiny, perfectly straight nose with a delicate upturned tip, high rounded apple cheeks, and a small soft pointed chin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Every enhanced feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about one hundred and thirty-three in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: three separate septum rings of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; four small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; ten small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit twenty-nine pieces above the lobe: fourteen classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, nine studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and six in the conch and tragus; twenty small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; sixteen small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these three iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly ten separate massive weights, each of a different shape, all of them dark brown bronze with a rough cast, uneven surface and green-black patina, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal: on the left ear a teardrop-shaped sinker on a shortest chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, a ship's anchor on a short chain, a square-sided cowbell on a short chain, a cube-shaped block on a medium chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a long chain, a round bell on a long chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a longer chain, a miniature anvil on a longer chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longest chain; on the right ear a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a shortest chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a short chain, a cube-shaped block on a short chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, a round bell on a long chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longer chain, a miniature anvil on a longer chain, a ship's anchor on a longest chain. On each ear the three iron rings share the weights between them in uneven numbers, each ring carrying its own column of weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between three openings, the weight pulls each earlobe down only very slightly into a soft, healthy loop of skin, a barely noticeable natural droop that is just enough to show the weights are heavy; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a dim lounge with deep teal velvet walls and a few soft blurred lamps in muted blue-green, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
